Party must have to provide executed order copy/copies of successfully execute d contract/s (Work Order/s) of Job contract for Civil Works for Road Construction in any CPWD/MES/ Railway/ Government of India undertaking/state Public Sector / lis ted companies having Company Identification Number (Not Private Limited) durin g last seven years ending last day of the month previous to the one in which offer s are invited fulfilling either of the following: -

Experience of successfully executed similar work i.e. construction of road during l ast 7 years fulfilling either of the following: (i) One (1) executed order copy of basic value not less than Rs 79.05 Lakhs (ii) Two (2) executed order copy of basic value not less than Rs. 49.40 Lakhs for e ach or (iii) Three (3) executed order copy of basic value not less than Rs. 39.52 Lakhs fo r each Successful Job completion certificate where the reference of work order is mentio ned is to be enclosed along with copy of such successfully executed contract for t he requisite values of PQC point no. 1. i) OR 1. ii) OR 1. iii). 2. The Bidder shall have positive net worth as per their latest audited financial sta tement. Relevant documentary evidence including copies of Annual Report, contai ning Profit & Loss Statement and Balance Sheets for immediate preceding three ( 3) consecutive accounting years ending March 2026 should be furnished together with the bid. Balance Sheet, Profit & Loss Account duly audited, stamped and sign ed by CA/CA Firm mentioning UDIN, FRN & MRN for Financial Year 2023-24, 2024- 25 and 2025-26 are to be enclosed. The Bidder should an average annual financial turnover of at least Rs 29.64 Lakhs during the last 3 years, ending 31st.March 2026 of the previous financial years. 3. Documentary evidence in support of above must be submitted along with the t echnical offer without which the offer after not be considered. Annexure-II (Scope of work) SCOPE OF WORK: 1. Mechanized Execution: Since the bituminous road work is required to be exe cuted in a mechanized manner, the bidder shall furnish documentary evidence of ownership of the required plant and machinery. Alternatively, the bidder may sub mit a valid agreement/Memorandum of Understanding (MoU)/consent with the ow ner of the required plant and machinery, confirming its availability and deployme nt for execution of the work throughout the contract period. The agreement/MoU s hall specifically cover the batch-type hot mix plant (minimum 60 TPH capaci ty) and other essential equipment proposed to be deployed for the work. Failure t o submit the requisite documentary evidence of ownership or a valid agreement/ MoU along with the bid shall render the bid non-responsive and liable for rejecti on. The bidder shall ensure the availability of the following minimum plant and ma chinery for execution of the work: 1. Tandem/Steel Drum Road Roller of minimum 10-ton capacity with thre e-stage vibration modes, in sound working condition. 2. Air Compressor of adequate capacity for cleaning the road surface prior to laying bituminous mix. 3. Mechanical Paver Finisher suitable for laying hot bituminous mix.

4. Hydraulic Dumpers/Tippers of suitable capacity with hydraulically operate d unloading system compatible with the paver finisher. 5. Automatic Bituminous Hot Mix Plant of minimum 60 TPH capacity (own ed by the bidder or covered through a valid agreement with a third-party o wner). 6. The Hot Mix Plant shall have a minimum production capacity of 60 TPH a nd shall be capable of producing bituminous mixes conforming to the specif ications and requirements stipulated in the BOQ. 7. Concrete mixers of adequate capacity, needle vibrators, concrete cutting machine for contraction/expansion joints, water tanker. The objective of the proposed work is to: Improve the riding quality and serviceability of the existing road. Reduce waterlogging and associated pavement deterioration. Provide suitable pavement treatment based on the existing condition of each road stretch. 2. Bituminous Road Treatment – The treatment shall consist of: Full pavement reconstruction for the severely damaged stretch; Surface preparation and BC overlay for the balance bituminous stretch; DBM strengthening wherever the existing base is found to have deteriorated ; Necessary drainage, compaction and finishing works associated with the pav ement rehabilitation. The exact extent of localized DBM strengthening shall be finalized based on site c onditions encountered during execution and the Engineer-in-Charge's assessment . The Contractor/Executing Agency shall: Plan the work in suitable stages and manageable sections. Provide and maintain temporary traffic diversions wherever required. Construct, grade, widen and maintain temporary diversion roads suitable for traffic movement . Provide necessary signage, barricading, warning arrangements and traffic co ntrol measures. Restore temporary diversion areas after completion of the permanent pavem ent works. No work shall be carried out in a manner that unnecessarily obstructs or disrupts t ransportation activities. 3. General Construction Requirements The executing agency shall be responsible for all activities necessary for satisfact ory completion of the work, including but not limited to: Site preparation and setting out; Mobilization and demobilization of manpower, machinery and equipment; Procurement and transportation of construction materials; Earthwork, excavation, dressing and levelling shoulders and disposal of exce ss materilas;

Pavement layer preparation and compaction; Bituminous works; Concrete works; Drainage and water management measures; Temporary traffic diversion arrangements; Road safety and traffic management; Quality control Cleaning and finishing of the completed road; Restoration of areas affected by construction activities. All construction materials and workmanship shall conform to the relevant project specifications, applicable Indian Standards/MoRTH requirements, and directions of the Engineer-in-Charge, as applicable. 4. Execution Sequence The work shall generally be executed in the following sequence, subject to site co nditions and operational requirements: 1. Site inspection, setting out and identification of work fronts. 2. Preparation of traffic management and diversion arrangements. 3. Construction of temporary diversions wherever required. 4. Reconstruction of the severely damaged bituminous stretch. 5. Localized DBM strengthening and preparation of the remaining bituminous r oad. 6. Laying of BC wearing course over the designated bituminous stretches. 7. Completion of drainage, shoulder, transition and finishing works. 8. Restoration of temporary diversions and affected areas. 9. Final inspection, rectification of defects and handing over of the completed r oad. The actual sequence may be modified by the Engineer-in-Charge depending upon production requirements, traffic movement, site conditions and availability of wor k fronts. 5. Quality Control and Inspection The executing agency shall ensure that all works are carried out with appropriate quality control measures. The following shall be ensured: Proper preparation and compaction of sub-grade and sub-base. Compliance of pavement materials with specified quality requirements. Proper laying temperature and compaction of bituminous materials. Adequate surface preparation before bituminous overlay. Proper level, line, camber/cross-fall and thickness of pavement layers. Quality and grade compliance of concrete paver blocks. Proper drainage and prevention of water accumulation. Necessary field tests and quality checks as directed by the Engineer-in-Char ge. Any defective or failed work identified during inspection shall be rectified by the e xecuting agency at its own cost. 6. Completion and Handover Upon completion of the works, the entire work shall be inspected jointly by the co ncerned representatives. The executing agency shall:

Remove construction debris and surplus material. Complete all pending finishing works. Restore temporary diversion and work areas. Ensure unobstructed movement of operational traffic. Rectify any defects observed during final inspection. Hand over the completed road in a safe, clean and traffic-worthy condition. The completed road shall provide improved riding quality, enhanced pavement du rability and safe, reliable access for movement of vehicles. 7. The successful bidder shall ensure complete of drain, clearing and removal of al l bushes, wild vegetation and shrubs up to a width of 5.0 metres on both sides of t he road along the entire stretch of the repair work undertaken, at their own cost b efore and during the execution of the works. Annexure-III (Statutory Royalties and Clearances) STATUTORY ROYALTIES AND CLEARANCES FOR BUILDING MATERIALS A. Payment of Royalties: The Contractor shall be entirely responsible for the paym ent of all statutory royalties, fees, and taxes applicable to all building and constru ction materials (including but not limited to sand, aggregate, stone, moorum, soil, and bituminised/concrete mix ingredients) utilized in the execution of civil works, r oad construction (flexible and rigid/concrete pavements), repair, and maintenanc e works. B. Authorised Sourcing & Documentation: All materials must be procured from sou rces authorized by the State Government. The Contractor must obtain valid No Ob jection Certificates (NOCs), Royalty Challans, or Clearances directly from the conc erned State Government Mining/Revenue Department or their officially authorized channel partners/agencies. C. Mandatory Submission for Bill Processing: The Contractor shall submit original copies of all matching Royalty Challans and NOCs issued by the authorized authori ty along with every running account (RA) bill and the Final Bill. These documents must verify that full royalty has been paid for the exact quantity of materials cons umed in the works. D. Withholding of Payment for Non-Compliance: Non-submission, partial submissio n, or submission of invalid/unverifiable royalty documents shall lead to the withho lding of the final bill payment (or any running bill payment) either in part or in full. E. Release of Withheld Amounts: The withheld payment shall only be released, wit hout any interest liability on the part of HCL, after the Contractor fully fulfills the s tatutory requirement by submitting the authentic, verified NOC/Royalty Challans. . 5.
